title: Inside decade, the neovim plugin can open the viewer in a scratch pane
body:
The neovim plugin in `editors/nvim/` starts `acre-gui --stdio` as a viewer. Inside decade, the viewer's window opens in a new pane beside neovim, because decade places it by the `DECADE_PANE` that neovim passed on.

decade reads a `DECADE_INTO=<pane name>` variable from a window's process environment and puts the window in that pane (decade issue decade-7736aa). The plugin can set it when it starts the viewer, so the viewer opens in a scratch pane.

## Open

- How the plugin learns the scratch pane's name: a setting in the plugin, or a question to decade.
close_reason: Jack on 2026-11-24: not useful. :AcreView already opens the viewer in a new pane beside neovim, which is what editing wants; targeting the scratch pane would need the pane named on nearly every use.
